label: s1_sub_004_woman_01
text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_02
text: So this is one of those Ten Sights of Paldea that\nI’ve heard so much about...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_01
text: You are correct, my dearest O’Nare! These are\nthe Fury Falls![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_03
text: I had expected something a bit more...grandiose.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_04
text: I can really feel the positive energy though,\ndullness notwithstanding.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_02
text: As positive as ever, my dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_03
text: Not only can I feel the positive energy flowing, I\ndaresay there’s Glitterati energy in the air as well![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_04
text: Truly, your Glitterati aura fills the air with a sense\nof rejuvenation! Pfwee, pfwee![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_05
text: Thank you for speaking the truth as always, Billy.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_06
text: Hold on—isn’t that our dear commoner? The one\nfrom before?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_05
text: Your eyes do not deceive you. That is indeed our\ndear commoner—the one from before![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_06
text: Could it be fate? Coincidence? Or maybe you’ve\nbeen drawn here by our Glitterati energy![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_07
text: Oooohoho! Indeed, indeed![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_08
text: It’s our duty as Glitterati to make the dreams of\nthe common folk a reality.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_09
text: Or more specifically, to give them fine items.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_10
text: Now, do pay attention, dear commoner. Money\nisn’t too dissimilar from positive energy.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_11
text: When you’re surrounded by it, it may bring you\ncalm and stability...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_12
text: BUT! You’ll never know for sure whether that\nhappiness you feel is true or not![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_07
text: O’Nare, please! Such pearls of wisdom are too\nprofound for a mere child![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_woman_13
text: Come, Billy! I want to go someplace more...\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]remote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]! A place that is not famous or renowned\r\nor anything![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_08
text: Pfwee! We’ve been to so many landmarks that\nshe’s tired of it! You really are an exemplary\r\nGlitterati, dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_man_09
text: I know just the place! It’s by the border between\nthe South Province’s Area Five and Area One![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_004_secretary_01
text: Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare went to the famous\nwaterfall in Area Two of Paldea’s North Province.
